title: OneDrive sync app: policy to exclude folders by name from upload on Windows and Mac
summary: Hold: the briefing says a matching folder exists only on its device, but Microsoft explicitly says previously synced folders and content are not removed from the cloud. The controls, default and roadmap details are supported; the assertions that sign-in and access do not change are not stated by the sources.

claims.where: Why it matters: first paragraph; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: A folder matched by the policy exists only on that device and does not reach the web or the user's other devices.
claims.quote: This setting doesn't retroactively remove a folder or its existing content from OneDrive or SharePoint.
claims.fix: Replace the categorical sentence in Why it matters with: 'New matching folders skipped by the sync app remain local; the policy does not remove a folder or its existing content already in OneDrive or SharePoint.' In Data exposure, change 'Folders matched by the policy' to 'New matching folders skipped by the sync app' so the local-only analysis does not include previously synced content. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/use-group-policy#exclude-specific-kinds-of-folders-from-being-uploaded.
